transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello! I'm Dora, your clinical conversational agent. I'm here to help answer any questions you may have about your cataract surgery recovery. Did you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can start doing light gardening, like gardening, brisk walking, gentle cycling, and light jogging, about 1 week after surgery. Just be gentle and avoid anything strenuous. Also, make sure to wear protective eyewear.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for the advice! My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You should start using preservative-free eye drops four times daily to start. You can get these from the pharmacist. If you were using eye drops before your surgery, it's safe to continue using them unless you've been told otherwise. Your GP can also provide you with more eye drops if you run out.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's good to know, thank you. Another question I have is about light sensitivity—I'm very sensitive to bright light, is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's normal to be a bit sensitive to light as your eyes adjust to the new lenses. If it's mild, wearing sunglasses when you're outside should help. But if it's severe or you have a red and painful eye, we may need to check it further.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Got it, thank you for explaining that. My last question is, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's common for the vision not to be completely clear in the first week after surgery, but it should improve quickly and settle down over time. If your vision is still blurry or getting worse, we may need to check it to make sure it's okay.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for all the helpful information. I don't have any more questions at the moment.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I'm glad I could help. Have all your questions about your cataract surgery recovery been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, you've answered all my questions. Thank you for your assistance!

verdict.label: pass
